title: Orders with no line items
statement_markdown: Return the ids of orders that contain no order_items. Sort by order id.

examples.explanation: This output comes from the visible sample data.

hints: Preserve all orders while attempting to match items.
After a LEFT JOIN, unmatched item columns are NULL.
explanation: LEFT JOIN keeps every order and produces NULL item columns for unmatched orders. Filtering oi.id IS NULL isolates those rows. A common mistake is INNER JOIN, which can never show an order without items. NOT EXISTS is an equally clear alternative.
reference_solution: SELECT o.id FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL ORDER BY o.id
